afterImage.description: US Energy Logistics is Sixth Street's manager-level name for its partnership with BP across core U.S. onshore midstream logistics assets. BP retains 51% and control while Sixth Street holds 49% through Lerado Investments and other undisclosed affiliates. The platform includes refined-products and crude-oil logistics interests; individual pipelines, terminals, operators and legal SPVs remain subordinate assets.
